summary: Feed s120_double to NDR is degraded: VLAN 20 traffic is missing/stripped (50% untagged) and encrypted share 94.2% exceeds NDR tolerance of 90%. No duplicates, one-way, drops, or overload detected.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP ingress is stripping 802.1Q tags or not trunking VLAN 20. 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is never observed, while NDR requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation visibility.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot segment or correlate traffic by VLAN, misses lateral movement and policy violations in VLAN 20, and loses detection coverage for that tenant/segment.

recommended_fix.why: Retain 802.1Q tags end-to-end from TAP/SPAN through packet broker to NDR so VLAN 20 is visible and filtering/correlation works.

findings.root_cause: 94.2% of bytes are TLS/encrypted, above the NDR's 90% tolerance. No inline decryption is present, so payload is opaque to the NDR which needs full payload for detection.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is limited to metadata/flow analysis only; cannot perform deep payload inspection, reducing detection of C2, exfiltration, and exploit payloads inside encrypted sessions.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypt once at the packet broker visibility layer and feed cleartext copy to NDR, or selectively bypass trusted high-volume encrypted flows, to bring inspectable traffic within NDR's effective range without breaking privacy/compliance.
